main:1.text: The scene opens with Peter Parker asleep on his bed, awoken by the buzzing of his cell phone. The camera pans to show a glimpse of his apartment, including photos with Aunt May, Uncle Ben, Mary Jane Watson, and Harry Osborn, newspapers from the Daily Bugle, schematics for suit improvements, and even comic books. It is also apparent Peter is behind on his rent.

main:2.text: The scene opens with Peter Parker asleep on his bed, awoken by the buzzing of his cell phone. The camera pans to show a glimpse of his apartment, including photos with Aunt May, Uncle Ben, Mary Jane Watson, and Harry Osborn, newspapers from the Daily Bugle, schematics for suit improvements, and even comic books. It is also apparent Peter is behind on his rent.

main:5.text: Via a phone call, Octavius assures Peter that the committee will calm down, and tells him not to bother coming back to the lab for clean-up, as he's stepping out for dinner. Believing that Octavius will be gone for the night, Peter goes to the lab to repair the damage caused to his Classic Suit by his fight with Kingpin. However, Octavius returns to the lab and catches him repairing the suit.

main:14.text: After helping out at one of Harry Osborn's research stations, Spider-Man receives a call from Yuriko Watanabe that the Shocker has escaped police custody, having apparently been let out by a guard, and is robbing again. On the way there, he receives a call from Mary Jane Watson where she explains the Inner Demons have attempted to fill the vacuum left by Wilson Fisk.

main:16.text: Upon finding out that he is evicted, Parker has no choice but to call sanitation to figure out where the dump truck is so he can recover his possessions. He calls about dumpster 64476 to track his USB Spidey-Drive, believing it more important than his other possessions. When he arrives at the final location, he finds thugs in the area, and rescues the worker who allows him to dig through the trash.

main:19.text: When Spider-Man arrives at the construction site, he finds that the Demons are eliminating Fisk's thugs and taking over. After defeating a few and taking a phone from a Fisk construction worker, Spider-Man talks to Fisk over the phone, and he reluctantly agrees to share more information if Spider-Man keeps Fisk's men alive. After Spider-Man rescued Fisk's men, he called Fisk to ask who led the Demons.

main:23.text: Otto Octavius calls, urging Peter to return to the lab. Once there, Peter witnesses Otto fail at using prosthetics, and curse out Norman Osborn in far more rage than before.

main:25.text: After receiving the alert, Spider-Man reached Standish' apartment complex and found Inner Demons under attack by police. After a firefight, he entered the building through the parking garage to find Standish by climbing the elevator. Spider-Man eventually reaches the penthouse and clears out the Inner Demons, then talks to Standish.

main:28.text: Peter Parker shares with Mary Jane Watson the demise of Isaac Delaney and also the name that Delaney ended up giving Martin Li: Morgan Michaels. Mary Jane lets him know that she dug up information that Norman Osborn and Wilson Fisk were apparently in league with each other, as Norman wanted Fisk to build him a secret lab. Spider-Man decides he needs to infiltrate Oscorp to see if he can find any further information.

main:30.text: After an uncomfortable call with Mary Jane Watson, while roaming the city, Peter Receives an urgent call from Otto Octavius inviting him to the lab for another test. Once in the lab, with Peter's help, Otto then tests the neural interface in tandem with his prosthetics with success. When Otto has trouble removing the cap, he reveals to Peter that he is suffering from a degenerative neurological condition.

main:31.text: After finishing in Otto Octavius' lab, Peter receives a text from Aunt May inviting him to the shelter to meet Miles, whose mother Rio Morales promised he was coming. On his way there, as Spider-Man, he spots Miles being mugged by a group of thugs. After rescuing him, Miles is excited by meeting Spider-Man, who gives him pointers on how to fight.

main:32.text: Peter Parker, after leaving the shelter, calls Yuriko Watanabe to inform her of his plans to check on Dr. Michaels. When she gives a warning that Silver Sable might shoot him on sight, he agrees to just "be in the neighborhood". When he arrives, he cannot find Michaels.

main:35.text: When Peter calls Miles to check up on him, Miles responds that though he wanted to quit at first, he was reminded of his father's words, "a hero's just a guy who doesn't give up", and realized that nothing Martin Li did was the fault of anyone at the shelter. Peter tells Miles he is proud of him, and then travels to the center to check up on Miles in person.

main:36.text: After Spider-Man arrives at the Sable International truck, Yuriko Watanabe meets him there via helicopter to reveal the situation is much worse, pointing to the Ryker's Island attack. Spider-Man hitches a ride with her and defeats many of the prisoners there, preventing them from stealing a chopper.

main:40.text: After his fight with Electro and Vulture, Spider-Man falls asleep from exhaustion on a rooftop, awakening the next morning. He calls Yuriko Watanabe to let her know he is going after Scorpion at the city's reservoir, believing that New York City would never recover if they lost clean water. Upon arrival, Scorpion gets the drop on Spider-Man.

side:5.text: After finding all the mascots hidden by Black Cat, Spider-Man ran an algorithm to track her location, believing if he caught her first he could stop her from robbing. Upon arriving at the hideout, he found several items, including financial data on the Maggia crime families, and art stolen from Wilson Fisk. He then discovered a recorded message left from Black Cat, in which she told him it was all a set-up.

side:17.text: A police officer expresses concern to Spider-Man that Wilson Fisk will be able to get out of jail due to the evidence being destroyed. A fan of J. Jonah Jameson's podcasts, he blames Spider-Man for the affair. As Spider-Man looks for the evidence, he bemoans that Jameson is so convincing. Spider-Man uses an RFID tracking tag to find the cargo truck containing the evidence, and returns it to the officer.

side:18.text: There are ten different art pieces scattered around the map: one in Central Park, two in Greenwich, three in Hell's Kitchen, two in Midtown, and two in Upper East Side. You'll be using locator to find stolen paintings. NYPD's Detective Mackey of the Greenwich precinct asks Spider-Man to track down paintings that were stolen by Walter Hardy when he still operated as the "Black Cat".

side:22.text: Each recording will result in a reward of 50 XP upon being found. After acquiring all nine recordings—three in Financial District, two in Chinatown, two in Greenwich, and two in Midtown—the side mission Scales of Justice is unlocked, which awards 1500 XP upon completion.

boss:1.text: Fisk was a major adversary of Spider-Man for eight years until the vigilante defeated him and ensured he was arrested. Upon arrest, Fisk warned that his arrest would create a power vacuum in the criminal underworld that other rival gangs would fight to fill. His warning consequently happened. While behind bars, Fisk had his men try to secure his release.

boss:2.text: In the game, Shocker appears as a boss battle when he was hired by Martin Li to rob a bank for the Inner Demons. In Marvel's Spider-Man 2, he was mentioned as one of the supervillains sought out by Kraven the Hunter. Herman was born in New York City around the year 1976.

collectible:2.text: To take a photograph, get close to the marked landmark location and press to activate the camera. While facing the landmark, use to zoom in the camera, and move the camera until the lens in the field-of-view turns green, then use to capture the image. Landmarks are scattered over the many districts and are pinpointed on the map.
